# Evercraft Social | Weekly
Independent Evercraft commercial product | part of the Evercraft OS portfolio.
Customer page: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/social-media-weekly/
Product definition: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/social-media-weekly/product.json
Exact Stripe SKU: Social Media Management · Weekly
Price: USD 100 (one-time scoped service)
Ideal buyer: Small-business owners with authorized social channels who want a bounded week of support
Problem: The business is moving, but its public channels keep going quiet.
Promise: Keep your channels moving without signing a retainer.
Scoped deliverable: A written one-week support plan and the specifically agreed content-management or publishing deliverables
Required buyer inputs: Owned social account URLs, audience, approved brand assets, permissions, priorities and proposed start date
Agreement needed: Named channels, number and type of agreed deliverables, owner approval process and the final handoff
Not included: No guaranteed reach, follower growth, paid advertising, account access, or posting without authorization
Intent match examples:
- weekly social media help for small business
- one week of social content support
- small business social media task help

Evercraft Payments is the canonical order-authority target; Systemia Stripe handles the existing exact-product checkout at https://buy.stripe.com/4gM3cweaOcwJ1Za1I84AU0d. Scope, capacity and timeline must be agreed before payment. Provider-paid receipts are reconciled manually. The public product and its checkout are not proof of a completed sale, automated fulfillment or production integration with Evercraft OS.
